places.name: The Fleet Stone
sources: lore: Lore:All Flags Navy; Lore:Battle of Argonia; Lore:Umbriel

why.founding: The All Flags Navy passed this coast and somebody put up a stone; two centuries later somebody else put up a second stone disagreeing with the first.
why.siteAdvantages: A headland facing the lane, where the stone is the only vertical thing.
why.occupantsMotive: Nobody lives here; offerings from two traditions accumulate at the base.
why.pressures: The two inscriptions cannot both be true and both are maintained.
why.wouldChangeIf: If either stone were pulled down the argument would become a feud.

places.name: Archon

why.founding: A deep, sheltered estuary mouth on the Padomaic was the one place on this coast a foreign hull could lie safely, so the Second Empire and then the East Empire Company built a stone quay here and the Saxhleel town grew landward of it.
why.siteAdvantages: Estuary with a landable stone shore, a river road into the interior, and the only stretch of the east coast where the jungle wall breaks for more than a kilometre.
why.occupantsMotive: An Argonian-majority harbour population who work the water as amphibians and run the port authority out of dead Company offices, alongside state customs and a long-settled Dunmer merchant minority from the Morrowind trade.
why.pressures: The lawful port is the province's only functioning customs choke, so everything that wants to avoid it goes round it; the jungle behind the city is D4 within a kilometre of the gate; the sealed Shadowscale sanctuary is a thing nobody will discuss and everybody knows about.
why.wouldChangeIf: If the Archon-Lilmoth-Soulrest-Tear line stopped running, or if the harbour authority lost its claim to the Company buildings, Archon would become a large fishing town in a month.

hardConstraints: deep water at the quay line at the highest seasonal level
preferences: estuary mouth commanding a river road
jungle wall kept back by cleared apron
sheltered from the prevailing sea squall

occupants: amphibious child population — canon civic colour

places.name: The Sunken Byre

why.occupantsMotive: Two drover families who work entirely submerged and are rich by village standards.
why.pressures: Foreign buyers want breeding stock and cannot legally take it; the stock is guarded underwater, which defeats most thieves.
why.wouldChangeIf: If the estuary silted or turned saline, the herd moves and the type disappears from the coast.

why.pressures: Salt intrusion is rising with the quay works, and the tree is smaller than it was a century ago.
why.wouldChangeIf: If the estuary silts or the harbour cuts a deeper channel, this Hist dies and Archon becomes a Hist-less city with a port.

places.name: The Closed Sanctuary

why.occupantsMotive: Nobody lives here. A watcher is paid to sit where he can see the path, by someone who has not visited in fourteen years.
why.pressures: The Cheydinhal Listener wanted it back; the harbour authority would rather it stopped existing; the birth-sign roll inside names living adults who do not know what they were promised to.
why.wouldChangeIf: If the roll were made public, or if the door were opened, half the Shadowscale line's premise collapses at once.
